WITH award_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(p.throws, 'missing') as throws,
    COUNT(*) as tally
  FROM manager_award ma
  JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id
  GROUP BY COALESCE(p.throws, 'missing')
),
total AS (
  SELECT SUM(tally)::NUMERIC as total_tally FROM award_counts
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    throws,
    tally,
    tally::NUMERIC / (SELECT total_tally FROM total) as share
  FROM award_counts
),
avg_share_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as average_share FROM with_shares
)
SELECT 
  SUM(tally) as combined_tally,
  AVG(share) as average_share,
  AVG(share) - (SELECT average_share FROM avg_share_calc) as above_average
FROM with_shares
WHERE share > (SELECT average_share FROM avg_share_calc)
